metadata.title: Implement ValidatedStrategy Base Class for rustybt

story.iWant: a base strategy class that auto-logs lifecycle events
story.soThat: rustybt strategies automatically produce structured logs for comparison

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: RustyBTValidatedStrategy base class implemented in rustybt/validation/base_strategy.py
_log_event() method implemented with structured event logging
Lifecycle methods auto-log (initialize, handle_data, signals, orders)
Log file cleanup with proper resource management

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR23-FR30 define requirements for dual strategy implementations, log generation, and comparison infrastructure.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: ValidatedStrategy base classes auto-log lifecycle events to JSONL. Schema: timestamp, layer, event, asset, data fields.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: JSON schema: {"timestamp": ISO8601, "layer": "data|signals|orders|broker|portfolio", "event": string, "asset": string|null, "data": object}

doc.title: Epic Definitions
doc.snippet: Story 2.1 defines ValidatedStrategy base class with auto-logging of lifecycle events for rustybt framework.

artifact.reason: Main validation package exports - will need to export RustyBTValidatedStrategy
Data models including ValidationLayer enum pattern and log schema types
Target file for implementation - may already exist with stub
rustybt's base algorithm class that RustyBTValidatedStrategy must extend
Validation test fixtures including tmp_path and data fixtures

constraints.constraint: Log format must be JSONL (one JSON object per line)
Flush after each write to prevent data loss on crash
Valid layer values: data, signals, orders, broker, portfolio

interface.name: _log_event
interface.signature: def _log_event(self, layer: str, event: str, data: dict) -> None

interface.name: TradingAlgorithm.handle_data
interface.signature: def handle_data(self, context: Any, data: Any) -> None

tests.standards: pytest-based testing with coverage ≥80%. Use pytest markers for validation layers. Property-based testing with Hypothesis for financial calculations. Type checking with mypy strict mode. Linting with ruff.

ideas.idea: Test that RustyBTValidatedStrategy creates log file at specified path
Test that _log_event writes valid JSONL with all required fields
Test that initialize() logs to layer "data", event "initialize"
Test that handle_data() logs to layer "data", event "bar_received"
Test that __del__ closes log file properly
Test context manager support for file handling
Test multiple events append correctly to file
